beschrijving: Rapport opgebouwd via opvolgende SQL queries per niveau.

levels.queryTemplate: SELECT o.label AS Header1, o.id AS startId FROM objects o WHERE o.id = :startId AND o.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT o.label AS Header2, o.id AS Id2 FROM objects o JOIN relation_values rv ON rv.target_id = o.id WHERE rv.source_id = :startId AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND rv.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY rv.volgorde
SELECT o.label AS Header3, o.id AS Id3 FROM objects o JOIN relation_values rv ON rv.target_id = o.id WHERE rv.source_id = :Id2 AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND rv.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY rv.volgorde
SELECT o.label AS Header4, o.id AS Id4 FROM objects o JOIN relation_values rv ON rv.target_id = o.id WHERE rv.source_id = :Id3 AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND rv.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY rv.volgorde
